UPDATE ht_rooms_new SET room_no = $1, room_type_id = $2, room_floor = $3, room_status = $4, room_clean = $5, room_maintenance = $6, room_price_weekday = $7::float8, room_price_weekend = $8::float8, room_price_special = $9::float8, room_notes = $10, updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE room_id = $11
